# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in SharpVision.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused behavioral or rendering tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation and the Showcase reflect the public surface, where
      applicable.
- [ ] `make format`, `make lint`, `make build`, and `make test` pass locally.
- [ ] Terminal-facing changes were checked in a representative terminal or tmux
      session, where applicable.

## Compatibility

- [ ] This preserves the documented public API and behavior.
- [ ] This intentionally changes a public contract and is labelled
      `breaking change`.
